vocabulary.definition: the killing of a large number of people
vocabulary.example: The war resulted in unimaginable carnage and destruction.

vocabulary.definition: injuring someone so severely that part of their body is permanently damaged
vocabulary.example: The accident left him severely maimed and unable to walk.

vocabulary.definition: a person or thing that causes great trouble or suffering
vocabulary.example: The pandemic was a scourge that affected millions of people worldwide.
Through vaccinations, smallpox was eradicated from the world.

vocabulary.definition: a ghostly figure; a haunting or disturbing possibility
vocabulary.example: The specter of war loomed over the region, causing fear and uncertainty.
Exploring the jungles of South America was an adventurous experience.
